title: Passive Voice: When to Use It — Quiz 117
content:
## Passive Voice: When to Use It

Choose active or passive voice according to the focus and purpose of a sentence.

### Lesson focus

1. The manager was badly beaten.
2. The wounded soldiers were taken to hospital.
3. English is spoken all over the world.
4. Tea is consumed all over the world.
5. The office is swept in the morning daily.

### Understand the pattern

Use the passive when the receiver or result matters more than the doer, or when the doer is unknown or obvious. Do not add an agent merely to make every example longer. Active voice is often clearer when responsibility is important.

### Worked answers and explanation

'The manager was badly beaten' focuses on the injured person. 'English is spoken all over the world' describes widespread use without listing speakers. 'The office is swept every morning' describes a routine; its agent may be obvious or irrelevant to the reader.

### Try another

Which better answers 'What happened to the window?': 'Someone broke the window' or 'The window was broken'?

### Suggested answer

The passive naturally keeps the window as the topic. The active is also grammatical, and may be better if the conversation focuses on who caused the damage.
